Global Research and Action Agenda for Climate Change and Mental Health
The Global Research and Action Agenda sets a vision for the climate and mental health field to understand and respond to the mental health consequences of a changing climate and ensure climate action promotes good mental health and wellbeing. It sets out priorities for research and action developed with 960+ experts in research, policy, practice, and lived experience across 90 countries.
